notes.title: Patch 2.0a
notes.notes:
This version has been optimized for x86_64 versions.
A major update is scheduled to be released shortly.

notes.title: New version of Hardpunch - End of December 2022
notes.notes:
A new version of Hardpunch (and Hardpunch Village) will be released on March 24th.
This new version will bring drastic changes (the Game will be in First Person, for example).

1) New Save System,
2) new characters,
3) Many weapons,
4) New names and nomenclatures,
5) New villains,
6) Same levels with a new design.
7) Bugs fixed
8) Performance improvements and FPS count

notes.title: Expected release by the end of June.
notes.notes:
Clockwork P*ssy to be Released as EARLY ACCESS.
Let's make sure you don't have the same problem that happened with Pornocrates (the game was supposed to be released as Early Access. But, a human error advanced the game to final release).

notes.title: Hardpunch Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
This new Hardpunch update introduces new features and new content. It is now possible to reset the saved game information, resetting the backup file.
This update restructures the main updates of the game that were carried out in the last 40 days to bring a new perspective.

New improvements (and bug fixes) will come in the next 30 days

notes.title: Hardpunch: Subverse Update v1.08.90 is available!
notes.notes:
Hi!
Finally, we are making available a new update for the game HardPunch Subverse world.

1) We introduced a new save system in the game,
2) We created a new navigation structure,
3) We added three more levels in the game (other levels will come soon),

Enjoy the Pleasure!!
